They don't know what to do - they've never played football before. Worm, Hennie and Ethel do their best to show them the rules, but it's all going in the wrong direction. How will they ever score a goal?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: On the beach, Bingo and Dad get creative when they find a stick shaped like a bird’s head.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey learns that adults take a little bit longer to make friends.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are adventure-seeking explorers who soar around the planet fixing environmental problems caused by Grandmaster Glitch!

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: With a landslide about to fall into the valley, Peter and his friends realise that a hibernating Mrs Tiggy-Winkle is in destruction's path! Can the friends avert disaster?

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. Kwazii and Dashi become entangled in a strange deep sea creature, a siphonophore, and when a geyser blasts it towards the surface, the Octonauts must stop its ascent before it bursts.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The Numberblocks make a new friend, football fan Eleven, who gets them all in training for the big match. Learn all about the number 11 with Numberblock Eleven!

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. O has fun doubling up and making new and different oo sounds in the words moon, foot and boot. He even gets to hoot like an owl!

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: When Millie the Squid devises a set of tough penguin games to test the Piripenguins, Pancake and Nugget must stick together and rely on their friendship to succeed.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun pretending to be frogs, and Kingsley and Queenie have a froggy fiesta. In Boxtropolis, Sketch splats a picture of a lily pad fit for a frog.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Coco is staying at Bing's house for a sleepover for the first time, and it's not long before the differences in their bedtime routines emerge. Coco has brought her collection of rainbow fairy mice with her, one of whom has a special trick that can only be seen in the dark. As soon as the light goes out Bing panics - he is frightened of the dark!

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘shoes’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. This episode is all about shoes – brown shoes, blue shoes, shiny shoes and new shoes. We see flashy shoes and dashy shoes, loud shoes and even flying shoes!

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu upsets Barnaby when she co-opts his favourite song.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Lou babysits some squawking little birds who drive him crazy.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: Ziff leads Pipp and Button to a fairground adventure, with help from faithful Bertie.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos are in a living room, where they see a man going outside into the garden through the patio doors. He brings some things outside with him, a chair and then a cushion, and finally a book which he starts to read. The Twirlywoos decide to move more things from inside the house to the outside, while the man obliviously continues reading. They get carried away, and when the man finally looks up from his book, he finds he is surrounded by the entire contents of the living room, even the sofa! Peekaboo gets stuck outside the boat and goes around it looking in through different windows and making noises which the Twirlywoos hear, but can't see who it is. Finally, Peekaboo manages to get back inside through the top of the boat.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin goes on an outdoor adventure with his friend. They build a den, meet an owl and sing around a campfire. Meanwhile, the Tumble family go on a camping trip, but Aunt Polly's snoring keeps everyone awake!

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of potatoes who sing songs in different genres. The potatoes go on an imaginary hippy journey and sing about the amazing things you can do when you give imagination a try.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies have their favourite things and the Noo-noo wants to join in. When the Tubby Phone rings, the Teletubbies and the Noo-noo do the Tubby Phone dance together.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Marta, Ferne, Inam, Isaac, Luther, Hawa and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are porridge oats which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby appropriate porridge oats inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun song ‘Pease Porridge Hot’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Together Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children plant sunflower seeds in decorated pots to grow beautiful flowers, learn British Sign Language signs for garden, grow and pretty, then sing and sign Mary, Mary, Quite Contrary.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Herb farmer Jekka introduces the Fact Pack to mint plants. They discover how mint grows, what makes it taste and smell so fresh, and how mint can be used in many different ways.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Musumbi the hippo and Bean the warthog have fun watching each other do their favourite things. Hamza finds some fabulous zebras and follows the rhinos on their walk in the wild.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes help a young Cornasaurolophus reach the top of a volcano.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey's playgroup is at odds when Indy's baby hospital collides with Rusty's knights and dragons. But in explaining themselves, they both find that their games actually have a lot in common.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are hungry, but they’re not sure what to eat to fill their tummies, so they turn to Duggee for help. Fortunately, he has his cookbook The Clubhouse Kitchen: Tasty Bites for Hungry Squirrels, and together they pick out something they’d like. They decide the nut roast takes too long to make, and although cheetah toast is quicker, they don’t like getting raisins stuck in their teeth. Once they’ve picked a recipe, Duggee teaches them how to complete it: get the ingredients, prepare them and then put it together. After making some fun mess in the kitchen and a great cooking lesson, the Squirrels get to complete the last step together and eat what they made. Delicious!

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Red is surprised to discover that she's not the only colour in the world when she meets Blue. Join the Colourblocks to learn which objects can be red and which can be blue, and how some can be both red and blue.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Bella has lots of questions about some very special beetles - lovely ladybirds! Ferne meets some sun beetles, horned flour beetles and purple jewel beetles at the zoo, while Rory and his son Sandy look for ladybirds in the greenhouse and build a hibernation station for the garden. Plus, we find out why ladybirds are great for the environment. They are pest controllers, who eat lots of little bugs that can destroy valuable crops.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Amanpreet and her family are off on a animal adventure! They visit a safari park where they join the lions for a spot of lunch from the safety of their safari bus. Later, Amanpreet turns her hand to zookeeping. The rhino’s need a mud bath and Amanpreet is ready to help - it’s a mucky job, but someone has to do it! She also gets to feed the giraffes, but will the gentle giants be tempted by her cabbage buffet?

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Suri's family are from Iran, a large country in the Middle East in the continent of Asia. She makes the traditional Iranian dish of chicken joojeh. Suri begins by marinating the chicken in natural yogurt, spring onions, turmeric powder and lemon juice. She then takes her special ingredient of saffron, grinds it down to a powder and adds salt and natural yogurt before she mixes it in with the rest of the marinade. Suri serves her chicken joojeh with tomatoes. They enjoy the meal while sitting on the floor, a traditional Iranian custom on special occasions. Will her friends like the special ingredient when it is cooked in her joojeh?

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In this episode, Maddie find out about books! First, she visits a library to learn how all the different types of books are stored in different sections. Then she uses her special cameras to show how the librarian helps us find a book in the library. We see how the books are sorted so that they all go back in the right place. Next, Maddie goes to a factory where books are made. She finds out how books start out as a big sheet of blank paper. Maddie shows us how this paper is printed with ink using a press and she finds out how the book pages are stitched together using a very fast machine with a needle and thread. She uses her special slow-motion camera to show us how each page of a book is made by being sucked up and folded in a special way.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: When a group of astronomers get lost on Woofton Hill at night, Dan and Jamie get their kit together for a night-time search. Pup-pup-POW!

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie head into the dark to meet some Senegal bushbabies. These shy creatures are nocturnal and only come out at night. Using special cameras, we see that they have satellite-like ears that constantly move around, trying to pick up the slightest sounds of their favourite food – like bugs. Next, they meet two dwarf crocodiles. These tiny crocs are doing target training. When they nudge a coloured target, they get fed. Bushbabies and dwarf crocodiles are very different animals, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona tries to teach Baba how to be a grown-up puffin.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Sonny finds an old musical safe, which only opens with the right musical code. With Yukee’s help, Sonny tries every tune he can think of, but none opens the box – until the answer appears in a very unexpected place!

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Mum's got a new sound bowl, and Maddie and Triggs are eager to join her for some meditation. Being still and listening to Mum's sound bowl is right up Triggs's street, but Maddie soon realises that people have very different ways to feel calm and relaxed.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are excited to learn that Mr Wobbly, the jelly juggler, is coming to town, and they can’t wait to see him. But they become impatient, so Duggee makes sure to explain to them that the week will fly by and there’s a lot to be done in that time. Duggee explains that a week is made up of seven days and what activities he does each day to stay busy. Each squirrel excitedly shares their usual plans between Monday and Friday so that they have something to look forward to while they wait for Mr Wobbly’s arrival.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The Numberblocks play an exciting game of bounceball and it's the Even Tops versus the Odd Blocks. Learn about odd and even numbers with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. Sing along as Magic E makes mischief and shows you how to turn a cap into a cape.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Maddie meets Alfie and Harley at the park to play some games relating to different parts of the body. Mr Tumble and the toys make up a dance routine. Everyone gets moving and grooving in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words foot, hand and dancing.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: A cloud appears in Teletubbyland and it begins to rain. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po watch the flowers bloom. Another cloud appears and it rains pink tubby custard!

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 149 million years, to the time of the ammonites - a kind of mollusc that lived in shoals and swam in the sea. His mission is to find an ammonite shell to replace the one he broke back at the museum. Along the way he witnesses bay turtles hatching and taking their first swim and comes face to face with an eustreptospondylus, a swimming dinosaur. But will Andy succeed before the museum opens?

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: It’s the Den’s summer fete, and Jaz is excited to do a chicken and egg mascot dance with her dad, but soon realises she’s double-booked herself and might not have time to do both.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: Series for young children that celebrates lots of different amazing machines. In this episode, motorcycle rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that are all built for fun! Grace skids down her track in a drift trike, then she shows off a cool car plane and drives a soapbox racer.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Eden and Ava pretend to be superheroes and go on a mission to rescue their toy!

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: While testing out the new Terra-Gup 6, Tweak crash lands in the desert.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Peter promises to find the mice a new home, locating an alternative mouse house proves to be an adventure in itself.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: After overhearing Duggee listening to a beautiful track by the Squirrel Valley Voices Choir, the Squirrels seek to learn more about the roles that make up a choir – basses, sopranos, altos and tenors. A distressed Eugene then alerts them that half of the choir have been taken sick and can’t perform that day. The Squirrels step up to take their place. Initially, when the newly arranged choir sing, the voices aren’t gelling together. Duggee teaches them the principles they must get right first, for the choir to succeed – breathing, pitch, volume, focus and timing. With a lot of practice, the Squirrels turn up to perform perfectly together and finally earn their Choir Badge.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Vida helps Sunny taste new things at the Sweetwood Food Festival.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea blows all the lanterns away during the Lantern Festival. Supertato struggles to get them all back and needs Broccoli’s help to save the day.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The ducklings blame Weasy for eating the entire supply of popcorn, but he insists it wasn't him! Victim of an injustice, Weasy sets up a trap to find out who the real thief is and prove his innocence.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Fabio’s yummy new sauce is so sticky that he gets stuck to Mojo’s bonnet. They have to do everything together until Bo figures out how to 'unsticky' that sauce!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: On the beach, Bingo and Dad get creative when they find a stick shaped like a bird’s head.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey learns that adults take a little bit longer to make friends.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: After 799 years of winning the Great Gnome Games, Great Gnanna is worried she can't defend her title. To help, the doctors remind her that she is just as fearsome as ever.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: When the ground begins to shake on Dino Island, Jen and Andy suspect the volcano is to blame. Eager to solve the mystery, our intrepid duo embark on an epic adventure to discover the source of the unusual rumbling sound and make a surprising discovery. Along the way, Andy meets not one, but two T rexes, a male and a female, while Jen finds a herd of Alamosaurus not far from the volcano.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Doug wants to be in the school show, so he asks Waffle to help him with his act. He reveals his new music kit made from household items. Waffle and Doug make music together using all of the different homemade instruments but Mrs Hobbs bangs on the wall from next door. She asks the Brooklyn-Bells to keep the noise down! Doug notices that Mrs Hobbs’ banging is in time with their musical beat - she’s really good. Doug has an idea and invites Mrs Hobbs to come round and join in properly.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: It’s a busy day at the Bake A Wish Café. Rafi wants to bake with Jake in the kitchen and help Dash at the Wizard Wagon in the park. She wishes to be in two places at once, and a magical portal lets her hop between them! It’s exciting at first, but things soon become muddled. Rafi grows tired and realises it’s too hard to do everything at once. With her dads’ support, she realises it’s sometimes better to focus on one thing at a time.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo meets Ezra’s grandson Jaxon, and they join Jared, Cynthia, Ezra and Terrence for a football match in the park - with Gran Gran as the referee! The game goes well, but JoJo doesn’t score any goals. Gran Gran reminds her she is good at catching and suggests she tries being a goalkeeper instead. With JoJo’s help, her team wins!

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck turn detectives when their friend Plate Girl loses her plate on a foggy day.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: A Sky Moo gives Small Clanger a strangely shaped little thing that it has found in space. None of the Clangers has a clue what it is. Small decides to give it to the Iron Chicken for her nest, but as she is flying back down in the Music Boat she sees a big thing with a strange piece missing in its side. Reuniting the little thing and the big thing has a very surprising result!

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo’s den is not big enough for two. BaBa wishes they could both be in it, so at Play Time, MeMo shows BaBa how to build one out of cushions and blankets. They love their cosy den. At Yummy Time, it starts to rain, so MeMo and BaBa build a den for the Yummies that’s just right and keeps them sheltered. Elewhale blows out a stream of water and creates an Ele-den for Fungi and Pungi.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Upsy Daisy wants to look at the pretty flowers in the garden, but Igglepiggle wants to ride in the Ninky Nonk. They go their separate ways, but when Igglepiggle finds the prettiest flower of all, he collects Upsy Daisy in the Ninky Nonk and takes her to see it.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Vernon Kay encourages you to focus on your dreams in this Bedtime Story.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s Potato dedicating a song to his Uncle Spud, who went on a spaceship to the moon.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: 'If you do a pretending game you can make your toy do anything you want.' Bing and Sula discover a new toy at Amma's creche - a talking ride-on car. It seems like fun until talkie taxi keeps saying the same thing over and over again. When the taxi crashes and is finally silenced, Bing and Sula use their imagination to play the game they really want to play.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Po gets on the Tubby Custard Ride and makes lots of tubby custard - far too much for Po to eat alone! Po choo-choos off to find Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa so all the Teletubbies can share in the tubby custard. In Tummy Tales, the children take a ride on a steam train.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: Explore the amazing world around us with baby monkey Tee and his Mum, Mo. Sing along, join in with stories and get ready for some family fun!

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea launches Supertato down the back of a sofa, but her plan goes wrong when she falls in too. Stuck inside with no obvious way out, they meet kooky Raisin, who lives down there with her collection of buttons. Raisin shows them the only way out of the sofa – a thread hanging from above. But Evil Pea climbs up first and undoes the thread, leaving Supertato trapped. Inspired by Raisin and her buttons, Supertato uses them, along with the thread, to create a pulley system to get out.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Coco are drawing Gilly a picture. When she and Popsie arrive, Bing goes to say hello, but while he does so Charlie makes a big squiggle on Bing's drawing! Gilly shows them a game called 'squiggling'. You draw a squiggle, and then your partner turns that squiggle into a new drawing. Bing loves this game and turns Charlie's squiggle into Popsie.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: With Mojo and Bo’s help, Ted dresses up as a pirate ship for the Pirate Parade, and swashbuckling Captain Dot hijacks him. Team Mojo must find their inner pirates and sail the streets to stop her.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Ant Soldiers are getting ready for exercise, but Sergeant Ant is determined to give them a hard time. After the intense exercising, get ready to experience what a true day in the office looks, feels and sounds like with the chickens. Next, there is some counting to be done as the Squirrels talk us through a dot-to-dot of a caterpillar. And join Professor Jeanie, who has fun facts about spiders. Finally, the Squirrels express their love of animals with an epic new song.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Red is surprised to discover that she's not the only colour in the world when she meets Blue. Join the Colourblocks to learn which objects can be red and which can be blue, and how some can be both red and blue.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Bella has lots of questions about some very special beetles - lovely ladybirds! Ferne meets some sun beetles, horned flour beetles and purple jewel beetles at the zoo, while Rory and his son Sandy look for ladybirds in the greenhouse and build a hibernation station for the garden. Plus, we find out why ladybirds are great for the environment. They are pest controllers, who eat lots of little bugs that can destroy valuable crops.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Amanpreet and her family are off on a animal adventure! They visit a safari park where they join the lions for a spot of lunch from the safety of their safari bus. Later, Amanpreet turns her hand to zookeeping. The rhino’s need a mud bath and Amanpreet is ready to help - it’s a mucky job, but someone has to do it! She also gets to feed the giraffes, but will the gentle giants be tempted by her cabbage buffet?

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Suri's family are from Iran, a large country in the Middle East in the continent of Asia. She makes the traditional Iranian dish of chicken joojeh. Suri begins by marinating the chicken in natural yogurt, spring onions, turmeric powder and lemon juice. She then takes her special ingredient of saffron, grinds it down to a powder and adds salt and natural yogurt before she mixes it in with the rest of the marinade. Suri serves her chicken joojeh with tomatoes. They enjoy the meal while sitting on the floor, a traditional Iranian custom on special occasions. Will her friends like the special ingredient when it is cooked in her joojeh?

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In this episode, Maddie find out about books! First, she visits a library to learn how all the different types of books are stored in different sections. Then she uses her special cameras to show how the librarian helps us find a book in the library. We see how the books are sorted so that they all go back in the right place. Next, Maddie goes to a factory where books are made. She finds out how books start out as a big sheet of blank paper. Maddie shows us how this paper is printed with ink using a press and she finds out how the book pages are stitched together using a very fast machine with a needle and thread. She uses her special slow-motion camera to show us how each page of a book is made by being sucked up and folded in a special way.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: When a group of astronomers get lost on Woofton Hill at night, Dan and Jamie get their kit together for a night-time search. Pup-pup-POW!

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie head into the dark to meet some Senegal bushbabies. These shy creatures are nocturnal and only come out at night. Using special cameras, we see that they have satellite-like ears that constantly move around, trying to pick up the slightest sounds of their favourite food – like bugs. Next, they meet two dwarf crocodiles. These tiny crocs are doing target training. When they nudge a coloured target, they get fed. Bushbabies and dwarf crocodiles are very different animals, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona tries to teach Baba how to be a grown-up puffin.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Sonny finds an old musical safe, which only opens with the right musical code. With Yukee’s help, Sonny tries every tune he can think of, but none opens the box – until the answer appears in a very unexpected place!

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Mum's got a new sound bowl, and Maddie and Triggs are eager to join her for some meditation. Being still and listening to Mum's sound bowl is right up Triggs's street, but Maddie soon realises that people have very different ways to feel calm and relaxed.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are excited to learn that Mr Wobbly, the jelly juggler, is coming to town, and they can’t wait to see him. But they become impatient, so Duggee makes sure to explain to them that the week will fly by and there’s a lot to be done in that time. Duggee explains that a week is made up of seven days and what activities he does each day to stay busy. Each squirrel excitedly shares their usual plans between Monday and Friday so that they have something to look forward to while they wait for Mr Wobbly’s arrival.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The Numberblocks play an exciting game of bounceball and it's the Even Tops versus the Odd Blocks. Learn about odd and even numbers with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. Sing along as Magic E makes mischief and shows you how to turn a cap into a cape.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Maddie meets Alfie and Harley at the park to play some games relating to different parts of the body. Mr Tumble and the toys make up a dance routine. Everyone gets moving and grooving in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words foot, hand and dancing.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: A cloud appears in Teletubbyland and it begins to rain. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po watch the flowers bloom. Another cloud appears and it rains pink tubby custard!

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 149 million years, to the time of the ammonites - a kind of mollusc that lived in shoals and swam in the sea. His mission is to find an ammonite shell to replace the one he broke back at the museum. Along the way he witnesses bay turtles hatching and taking their first swim and comes face to face with an eustreptospondylus, a swimming dinosaur. But will Andy succeed before the museum opens?

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: It’s the Den’s summer fete, and Jaz is excited to do a chicken and egg mascot dance with her dad, but soon realises she’s double-booked herself and might not have time to do both.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: Series for young children that celebrates lots of different amazing machines. In this episode, motorcycle rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that are all built for fun! Grace skids down her track in a drift trike, then she shows off a cool car plane and drives a soapbox racer.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Eden and Ava pretend to be superheroes and go on a mission to rescue their toy!

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: While testing out the new Terra-Gup 6, Tweak crash lands in the desert.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Peter promises to find the mice a new home, locating an alternative mouse house proves to be an adventure in itself.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: After overhearing Duggee listening to a beautiful track by the Squirrel Valley Voices Choir, the Squirrels seek to learn more about the roles that make up a choir – basses, sopranos, altos and tenors. A distressed Eugene then alerts them that half of the choir have been taken sick and can’t perform that day. The Squirrels step up to take their place. Initially, when the newly arranged choir sing, the voices aren’t gelling together. Duggee teaches them the principles they must get right first, for the choir to succeed – breathing, pitch, volume, focus and timing. With a lot of practice, the Squirrels turn up to perform perfectly together and finally earn their Choir Badge.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Vida helps Sunny taste new things at the Sweetwood Food Festival.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea blows all the lanterns away during the Lantern Festival. Supertato struggles to get them all back and needs Broccoli’s help to save the day.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The ducklings blame Weasy for eating the entire supply of popcorn, but he insists it wasn't him! Victim of an injustice, Weasy sets up a trap to find out who the real thief is and prove his innocence.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Fabio’s yummy new sauce is so sticky that he gets stuck to Mojo’s bonnet. They have to do everything together until Bo figures out how to 'unsticky' that sauce!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: On the beach, Bingo and Dad get creative when they find a stick shaped like a bird’s head.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey learns that adults take a little bit longer to make friends.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: After 799 years of winning the Great Gnome Games, Great Gnanna is worried she can't defend her title. To help, the doctors remind her that she is just as fearsome as ever.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: When the ground begins to shake on Dino Island, Jen and Andy suspect the volcano is to blame. Eager to solve the mystery, our intrepid duo embark on an epic adventure to discover the source of the unusual rumbling sound and make a surprising discovery. Along the way, Andy meets not one, but two T rexes, a male and a female, while Jen finds a herd of Alamosaurus not far from the volcano.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Doug wants to be in the school show, so he asks Waffle to help him with his act. He reveals his new music kit made from household items. Waffle and Doug make music together using all of the different homemade instruments but Mrs Hobbs bangs on the wall from next door. She asks the Brooklyn-Bells to keep the noise down! Doug notices that Mrs Hobbs’ banging is in time with their musical beat - she’s really good. Doug has an idea and invites Mrs Hobbs to come round and join in properly.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: It’s a busy day at the Bake A Wish Café. Rafi wants to bake with Jake in the kitchen and help Dash at the Wizard Wagon in the park. She wishes to be in two places at once, and a magical portal lets her hop between them! It’s exciting at first, but things soon become muddled. Rafi grows tired and realises it’s too hard to do everything at once. With her dads’ support, she realises it’s sometimes better to focus on one thing at a time.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo meets Ezra’s grandson Jaxon, and they join Jared, Cynthia, Ezra and Terrence for a football match in the park - with Gran Gran as the referee! The game goes well, but JoJo doesn’t score any goals. Gran Gran reminds her she is good at catching and suggests she tries being a goalkeeper instead. With JoJo’s help, her team wins!

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck turn detectives when their friend Plate Girl loses her plate on a foggy day.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: A Sky Moo gives Small Clanger a strangely shaped little thing that it has found in space. None of the Clangers has a clue what it is. Small decides to give it to the Iron Chicken for her nest, but as she is flying back down in the Music Boat she sees a big thing with a strange piece missing in its side. Reuniting the little thing and the big thing has a very surprising result!

Elewhale blows out a stream of water and creates an Ele-den for Fungi and Pungi.

programme.title: Millionaire Hot Seat
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson hosts the exciting and fast-paced quiz where each episode sees six hopefuls compete for a one-million-pound prize - however, only one player can take their place in the Hot Seat at a time and answer multiple-choice questions to work their way up the Money Ladder. Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Each player is given one Pass - a chance to pass the question on to the next player - but in doing so forfeit their place in the Hot Seat and risk not making it back there later on. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: Reece wakes from a surreal nightmare to find Disneyland Darren standing in his bedroom after Jodie lets him stay in the spare room. His return sparks tension with Mr Dunn, now dating Jodie, and Darren’s chaos disrupts the household. At school, it’s Refugee Awareness Week led by the woke Brimble. After derailing events with pranks, Reece is forced by headmaster Meachy to help her, but another prank goes too far and publicly humiliates her, leaving him unexpectedly feeling guilty. Meanwhile, Darren’s jealousy of Dunn spirals into absurd mind games. At Jodie’s 40th birthday party, Darren and Dunn compete for attention with speeches and dance routines. The mood shifts when Jodie takes in two kids after their mum is sectioned, helping Reece realise real care can be helping those closer to home. He later shares this with The Brimble, beginning an unlikely friendship.

programme.title: Keane & Vieira - Best of Enemies
programme.desc: Roy Keane and Patrick Vieira hated each other - Keane described himself as being 'in a war' with Vieira, and their infamous tunnel bust-up in February 2005 has entered folklore. They fought on the pitch and they tried to fight off of it, but most fans would agree that Roy Keane and Patrick Vieira were the two footballing warriors that defined their age. In this explosive documentary, the two men come together to explain why they hated each other, what they really thought of Sir Alex Ferguson and Arsene Wenger, and what it means to be the best of enemies.

Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Each player is given one Pass - a chance to pass the question on to the next player - but in doing so forfeit their place in the Hot Seat and risk not making it back there later on. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash.

programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson hosts the exciting and fast-paced quiz where each episode sees six hopefuls compete for a one-million-pound prize - however, only one player can take their place in the Hot Seat at a time and answer multiple-choice questions to work their way up the Money Ladder. Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Each player is given one Pass - a chance to pass the question on to the next player - but in doing so forfeit their place in the Hot Seat and risk not making it back there later on. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: Reece wakes from a surreal nightmare to find Disneyland Darren standing in his bedroom after Jodie lets him stay in the spare room. His return sparks tension with Mr Dunn, now dating Jodie, and Darren’s chaos disrupts the household. At school, it’s Refugee Awareness Week led by the woke Brimble. After derailing events with pranks, Reece is forced by headmaster Meachy to help her, but another prank goes too far and publicly humiliates her, leaving him unexpectedly feeling guilty. Meanwhile, Darren’s jealousy of Dunn spirals into absurd mind games. At Jodie’s 40th birthday party, Darren and Dunn compete for attention with speeches and dance routines. The mood shifts when Jodie takes in two kids after their mum is sectioned, helping Reece realise real care can be helping those closer to home. He later shares this with The Brimble, beginning an unlikely friendship.

programme.title: Keane & Vieira - Best of Enemies
programme.desc: Roy Keane and Patrick Vieira hated each other - Keane described himself as being 'in a war' with Vieira, and their infamous tunnel bust-up in February 2005 has entered folklore. They fought on the pitch and they tried to fight off of it, but most fans would agree that Roy Keane and Patrick Vieira were the two footballing warriors that defined their age. In this explosive documentary, the two men come together to explain why they hated each other, what they really thought of Sir Alex Ferguson and Arsene Wenger, and what it means to be the best of enemies.

programme.title: Millionaire Hot Seat
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson hosts the exciting and fast-paced quiz where each episode sees six hopefuls compete for a one-million-pound prize - however, only one player can take their place in the Hot Seat at a time and answer multiple-choice questions to work their way up the Money Ladder. Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Each player is given one Pass - a chance to pass the question on to the next player - but in doing so forfeit their place in the Hot Seat and risk not making it back there later on. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: Reece wakes from a surreal nightmare to find Disneyland Darren standing in his bedroom after Jodie lets him stay in the spare room. His return sparks tension with Mr Dunn, now dating Jodie, and Darren’s chaos disrupts the household. At school, it’s Refugee Awareness Week led by the woke Brimble. After derailing events with pranks, Reece is forced by headmaster Meachy to help her, but another prank goes too far and publicly humiliates her, leaving him unexpectedly feeling guilty. Meanwhile, Darren’s jealousy of Dunn spirals into absurd mind games. At Jodie’s 40th birthday party, Darren and Dunn compete for attention with speeches and dance routines. The mood shifts when Jodie takes in two kids after their mum is sectioned, helping Reece realise real care can be helping those closer to home. He later shares this with The Brimble, beginning an unlikely friendship.

programme.title: Keane & Vieira - Best of Enemies
programme.desc: Roy Keane and Patrick Vieira hated each other - Keane described himself as being 'in a war' with Vieira, and their infamous tunnel bust-up in February 2005 has entered folklore. They fought on the pitch and they tried to fight off of it, but most fans would agree that Roy Keane and Patrick Vieira were the two footballing warriors that defined their age. In this explosive documentary, the two men come together to explain why they hated each other, what they really thought of Sir Alex Ferguson and Arsene Wenger, and what it means to be the best of enemies.

His return sparks tension with Mr Dunn, now dating Jodie, and Darren’s chaos disrupts the household. At school, it’s Refugee Awareness Week led by the woke Brimble. After derailing events with pranks, Reece is forced by headmaster Meachy to help her, but another prank goes too far and publicly humiliates her, leaving him unexpectedly feeling guilty. Meanwhile, Darren’s jealousy of Dunn spirals into absurd mind games. At Jodie’s 40th birthday party, Darren and Dunn compete for attention with speeches and dance routines. The mood shifts when Jodie takes in two kids after their mum is sectioned, helping Reece realise real care can be helping those closer to home. He later shares this with The Brimble, beginning an unlikely friendship.

programme.title: Romesh Ranganathan's Parents' Evening
programme.desc: Mel B, Jonathan Ross and Richard Madeley have their kids' fate in their hands as they compete in the comedy game show that hinges on meeting parents' expectations - Mel B's faith in her daughter Phoenix gets brought into question, Jonathan has an outrageous idea for how Honey can turn an impediment into an advantage, and Chloe Madeley shares her dad's tendency to expose himself in the Madeley kitchen. programme.title: Millionaire Hot Seat
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson hosts the exciting and fast-paced quiz where each episode sees six hopefuls compete for a one-million-pound prize - however, only one player can take their place in the Hot Seat at a time and answer multiple-choice questions to work their way up the Money Ladder. Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Each player is given one Pass - a chance to pass the question on to the next player - but in doing so forfeit their place in the Hot Seat and risk not making it back there later on. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash.

programme.title: Keane & Vieira - Best of Enemies
programme.desc: Roy Keane and Patrick Vieira hated each other - Keane described himself as being 'in a war' with Vieira, and their infamous tunnel bust-up in February 2005 has entered folklore. They fought on the pitch and they tried to fight off of it, but most fans would agree that Roy Keane and Patrick Vieira were the two footballing warriors that defined their age. In this explosive documentary, the two men come together to explain why they hated each other, what they really thought of Sir Alex Ferguson and Arsene Wenger, and what it means to be the best of enemies.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: Reece wakes from a surreal nightmare to find Disneyland Darren standing in his bedroom after Jodie lets him stay in the spare room. His return sparks tension with Mr Dunn, now dating Jodie, and Darren’s chaos disrupts the household. At school, it’s Refugee Awareness Week led by the woke Brimble. After derailing events with pranks, Reece is forced by headmaster Meachy to help her, but another prank goes too far and publicly humiliates her, leaving him unexpectedly feeling guilty. Meanwhile, Darren’s jealousy of Dunn spirals into absurd mind games. At Jodie’s 40th birthday party, Darren and Dunn compete for attention with speeches and dance routines. The mood shifts when Jodie takes in two kids after their mum is sectioned, helping Reece realise real care can be helping those closer to home. He later shares this with The Brimble, beginning an unlikely friendship.

programme.title: Millionaire Hot Seat
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson hosts the exciting and fast-paced quiz where each episode sees six hopefuls compete for a one-million-pound prize - however, only one player can take their place in the Hot Seat at a time and answer multiple-choice questions to work their way up the Money Ladder. Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Each player is given one Pass - a chance to pass the question on to the next player - but in doing so forfeit their place in the Hot Seat and risk not making it back there later on. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash.

programme.title: Keane & Vieira - Best of Enemies
programme.desc: Roy Keane and Patrick Vieira hated each other - Keane described himself as being 'in a war' with Vieira, and their infamous tunnel bust-up in February 2005 has entered folklore. They fought on the pitch and they tried to fight off of it, but most fans would agree that Roy Keane and Patrick Vieira were the two footballing warriors that defined their age. In this explosive documentary, the two men come together to explain why they hated each other, what they really thought of Sir Alex Ferguson and Arsene Wenger, and what it means to be the best of enemies.

programme.title: You'll Never Get Rich
programme.desc: 1941. Comedy. Directed by Sidney Lanfield. Stars Fred Astaire, Rita Hayworth & Robert Benchley. A womanising theatre producer's efforts to cover up an affair leads to romance for a dance duo. [S]

programme.title: A Lifetime Ago with The...
programme.desc: ... Baim Collection. Between Those Four Walls. A nostalgic reminder of 1962 interior home decoration overloaded with facts and figures, with an insight into paper, manufacture and wallpaper design.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: By the Deep Six. Western with Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray, who run a stagecoach line in the Old West where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress. [S]

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: Bad Company. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Judy Geeson & Kenneth Farrington. A new commanding officer's method of discipline border on psychotic, the men consider mutiny.

programme.title: Black Saddle
programme.desc: 1959. The Apprentice. Western with Peter Breck. After his brothers are killed in a shootout, a gunfighter decides to hang up his guns and uphold the law by becoming a lawyer.

programme.title: Life In Emergency Ward 10
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Based on the smash hit TV series about the daily life and the ups and downs of a hospital. Stars Michael Craig, Wilfred Hyde-White and Joan Sims. [S]

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout June. [S]

programme.title: The Durant Affair
programme.desc: 1962. Drama. Directed by Godfrey Grayson. Stars Jane Griffiths, Conrad Phillips. When a wealthy society hostess dies, the search begins for the rightful heir, unveiling an unexpected heiress. [S]

programme.title: Paul Temple's Triumph
programme.desc: 1950. Nettlefold Films production directed by Maclean Rogers and starring John Bentley & Dinah Sheridan. Paul Temple is on the hunt for a kidnapped scientist who's invented a secret formula. [S]

programme.title: Laurel and Hardy - The Magicians
programme.desc: 1929. rare short piece of the duo performing as magicians, with hilarious results. [S]

programme.title: Star Performance: To Kill a Man
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by James Neilson. Stars Alexis Smith, Scott Forbes, Dan Barton & Ross Elliott. A dinner party is unexpectedly interrupted by an intruder. [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Monks Hood Murder. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Charles Morgan. Mrs. Vincent makes a complaint that Dr. Sneddon murdered her husband, he said he died of consumption. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: The Black Castle. 1956. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. Torwald holds Lord Trebizond to ransom in the Black Castle. Lorraine, rides to Camelot to seek help. [S]

programme.title: Seance On A Wet Afternoon
programme.desc: 1964. Thriller. Director: Bryan Forbes. Stars Richard Attenborough, Nanette Newman & Kim Stanley. A medium stages a kidnapping which she will then 'solve' by pretending to be psychic. [S]

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Betty Curtis unlocks the vault to bring you a fabulous performance of Soldi Soldi Soldi.

programme.title: Blackout
programme.desc: 1950. Crime Noir. Director: Robert S Baker. Written by John Gilling. Stars Maxwell Reed & Dinah Sheridan. An ambulance drops a blind patient to the wrong address, where he stumbles over a body. [S]

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: The Newcastle Train Murder. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Judith Rowbotham & Alan Moss. The murder of John Innes Nisbet in 1910 resulted in his killer becoming the last man hanged by Newcastle jail. [S]

programme.title: Strange But True?
programme.desc: UFOs - Pilots/Kaikoura Lights. 1995. Michael Aspel introduces pilots who speak for the first time about UFOs they have seen and UFO sightings on one night in the Kaikoura Peninsula in New Zealand. [S]

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: The Hammond Account. 1974. Stars Robin Chadwick, Derek Benfield & Jennifer Wilson. Hammond Transport is once again in the position for expansion. Barbara returns from abroad with some news. [S]

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Field Goal. 1958. Stars Donald Gray, Gordon Tanner & Colin Tapley. Mark Saber and Larry Nelson are investigating the murder of Mrs Radford's husband. [S]

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters...
programme.desc: ...Social Club. Episode 2. 1974. Performances from some of the best known singers of the time. Featuring, the Three Degrees, Ronnie Hilton and Bill Haley and the Comets perform their famous hits. [S]

programme.title: Adventures of a Private Eye
programme.desc: 1977. Comedy. Director: Stanley Long. Stars Chris Neil, Suzy Kendall, Harry H. Corbett. While his boss is away, Bob helps a model being blackmailed, finds a dead body & ends up in a cabaret club. [S]

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: 1989. Drama. Director: Michael Caton-Jones. Stars John Hurt, Joanne Whalley & Bridget Fonda. An affair between an exotic dancer and the Minister of War shakes up the British government. [S]

programme.title: Millionaire Hot Seat
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson hosts the exciting and fast-paced quiz where each episode sees six hopefuls compete for a one-million-pound prize - however, only one player can take their place in the Hot Seat at a time and answer multiple-choice questions to work their way up the Money Ladder. Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Each player is given one Pass - a chance to pass the question on to the next player - but in doing so forfeit their place in the Hot Seat and risk not making it back there later on. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: Reece wakes from a surreal nightmare to find Disneyland Darren standing in his bedroom after Jodie lets him stay in the spare room. His return sparks tension with Mr Dunn, now dating Jodie, and Darren’s chaos disrupts the household. At school, it’s Refugee Awareness Week led by the woke Brimble. After derailing events with pranks, Reece is forced by headmaster Meachy to help her, but another prank goes too far and publicly humiliates her, leaving him unexpectedly feeling guilty. Meanwhile, Darren’s jealousy of Dunn spirals into absurd mind games. At Jodie’s 40th birthday party, Darren and Dunn compete for attention with speeches and dance routines. The mood shifts when Jodie takes in two kids after their mum is sectioned, helping Reece realise real care can be helping those closer to home. He later shares this with The Brimble, beginning an unlikely friendship.

programme.title: Romesh Ranganathan's Parents' Evening
programme.desc: Mel B, Jonathan Ross and Richard Madeley have their kids' fate in their hands as they compete in the comedy game show that hinges on meeting parents' expectations - Mel B's faith in her daughter Phoenix gets brought into question, Jonathan has an outrageous idea for how Honey can turn an impediment into an advantage, and Chloe Madeley shares her dad's tendency to expose himself in the Madeley kitchen. Romesh also teaches his mum how to deliver bad news to a Spice Girl and Shanthi shares a cherished memory involving a window, the fire brigade, and a 'pair of round buttocks'.

programme.title: Keane & Vieira - Best of Enemies
programme.desc: Roy Keane and Patrick Vieira hated each other - Keane described himself as being 'in a war' with Vieira, and their infamous tunnel bust-up in February 2005 has entered folklore. They fought on the pitch and they tried to fight off of it, but most fans would agree that Roy Keane and Patrick Vieira were the two footballing warriors that defined their age. In this explosive documentary, the two men come together to explain why they hated each other, what they really thought of Sir Alex Ferguson and Arsene Wenger, and what it means to be the best of enemies.

programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson hosts the exciting and fast-paced quiz where each episode sees six hopefuls compete for a one-million-pound prize - however, only one player can take their place in the Hot Seat at a time and answer multiple-choice questions to work their way up the Money Ladder. Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Each player is given one Pass - a chance to pass the question on to the next player - but in doing so forfeit their place in the Hot Seat and risk not making it back there later on. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash.

Meanwhile, Darren’s jealousy of Dunn spirals into absurd mind games. At Jodie’s 40th birthday party, Darren and Dunn compete for attention with speeches and dance routines. The mood shifts when Jodie takes in two kids after their mum is sectioned, helping Reece realise real care can be helping those closer to home. He later shares this with The Brimble, beginning an unlikely friendship.
